map.注：大量蛋白尿和低白蛋白血症为必要条件: Note: heavy proteinuria and hypoalbuminemia are the necessary conditions
map.提示：24h尿蛋白定量是评估蛋白尿的金标准，但受尿液收集准确性影响。建议同时查U: Note: 24h urine protein quantification is the gold standard for assessing proteinuria, but it is affected by urine collection accuracy. It is recommended to check UACR at the same time for cross-validation. Exercise, fever and orthostatic position can cause physiological proteinuria. This tool is for learning reference only.
map.24h 蛋白 1.5g、尿量 1500mL→浓度约 1.0g/L，未达肾病范围(: 24h protein 1.5 g, urine volume 1500 mL → concentration about 1.0 g/L, not reaching the nephrotic range (<3.5 g).

map.留尿天数不足会低估，建议完整 24h 并记录总量。: Insufficient collection days will underestimate it; a complete 24h collection with total volume recorded is recommended.

A professional medical tool based on authoritative medical standards, for reference only.
24-hour urine protein grading: <0.15 g normal, 0.15–0.5 g/d mild, 0.5–3.5 g/d moderate, ≥3.5 g/d nephrotic-range proteinuria. Cut points follow the albuminuria grading approach in KDIGO 2012 CKD guideline.
map.≥3.5 g/d 只提示肾病范围蛋白尿，不能单独诊断肾病综合征: ≥3.5 g/d only indicates nephrotic-range proteinuria and cannot alone diagnose nephrotic syndrome
map.（后者还需血清白蛋白 <30 g/L 与水肿），需临床复核。: (the latter also requires serum albumin <30 g/L and edema); clinical review required.
map.24h 尿蛋白 ≥3.5 g，属肾病综合征范围蛋白尿；但肾病综合征的诊断还需血清: 24h urine protein ≥3.5 g is nephrotic-range proteinuria; however, nephrotic syndrome also requires serum albumin <30 g/L and edema, so this page cannot confirm it alone. Assess serum albumin, lipids and renal function; screen for secondary causes (diabetes, SLE, malignancy); nephrology should decide whether biopsy is needed.
